text:
Alex (AE): Hey team — ProspectX SIG is nearly finished but the customer's security reviewer flagged three items that need evidence: Q12 (tenant isolation), Q27 (KMS rotation policy), and Q31 (network segmentation). They want a zipped evidence package by EOD PST. Can Eng/Sec help collect artifacts?
Maria (SecOps): I can take Q12 and Q27. For tenant isolation I can provide the VPC/namespace mapping, the network policy snippet, and a short architecture diagram. Which deployment model are we documenting — hosted or Dedicated?
Alex (AE): Dedicated (reserved GPU pool). Customer is insistent on per-tenant isolation proofs for the Dedicated offering.
Jon (Infra): Ok — for Q12 I'll grab the node pool annotations and our sidecar isolation policy. Pasting the relevant YAML snippet here for reviewer copy/paste:
Jon (Infra): ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    redwood.com/tenant-id: "proj-456"
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    redwood.pool: dedicated-proj-456
  tolerations:
    - key: "dedicated"
      operator: "Equal"
      value: "proj-456"
networkPolicy:
  ingress:
    - from:
      - namespaceSelector:
          matchLabels:
            tenant: proj-456
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
```
Maria (SecOps): For KMS rotation (Q27) we use a scheduled job that rotates keys every 90 days and records the rotation event to audit logs. Runbook is at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation — I'll export the last 6 rotation entries for them.
SecurityBot: Evidence bundle template and checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec/evidence-template.zip — includes metadata.csv, proof-of-ownership.txt, minimal diagrams guidelines.
Jon (Infra): Quick cli output to include for network policies (redacted):
Jon (Infra): ```
$ kubectl get networkpolicies -n prod | grep tenant-proj-456
tenant-proj-456-policy   default  Ingress  2025-11-03
```
Maria (SecOps): For Q31 (network segmentation) I'll attach firewall rule IDs (fw-acc-125, fw-eu-78) and the diagram link: https://redwood.cloud/diagrams/segmentation-proj456.png — will include the ingress/egress CIDR mappings and peering deny rule.
Emily (SalesOps): I can assemble and sign the zip. Please drop artifacts (YAML, logs, diagrams, runbook exports) into the shared folder: s3://redwood-evidence/prospectx/1719900000/ — I'll grab them and run the packaging checklist.
Alex (AE): Great — @Maria and @Jon please upload the export files to that S3 path. I'll tell the customer we expect a signed package by EOD PST and that it will contain rotation logs, network policy YAML, firewall rule references, and the architecture diagram. :thumbsup:
Maria (SecOps): Uploading rotation_export.csv and diag_poc456.png now (will post S3 paths when done).
Jon (Infra): Uploaded `networkpolicy_proj456.yaml` and minimal `kubectl_output.txt` to the S3 path.
Emily (SalesOps): Received the files, assembling now. ETA 3 hours. I'll post the final S3 zip link here when ready.
Alex (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the customer after Emily posts the package.
SecurityBot: Reminder: include proof-of-ownership (signed internal checklist) and the evidence.csv metadata file per template.
Emily (SalesOps): Package done and uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/prospectx/1719900000/prospectx-sig-evidence-v1.zip — sharing with customer now.
Alex (AE): Awesome — closing the loop with the reviewer. If they ask for any clarifications I'll reopen thread.
Emily (SalesOps): Noted. :white_check_mark:
